name: terraform-json-nested-blocks-as-attributes
body: In Terraform JSON syntax, an object nested inside a block body (lifecycle, provisioner, dynamic, a nested provider block, …) is mapped as an attribute, not a nested block, because the frontend carries no per-block-type schema; its ${…} strings still yield references. Native-syntax nested blocks are unaffected. Upgrade by passing a per-kind body schema to the JSON mapping when a nested JSON block must become a Struct or scope a dynamic-block iterator.
